description: This file declares utility functions for creating WebRTC peer connection components and threads, including functions to create and start threads, create peer connection factory, and create peer connections with specified ICE servers and port ranges.

methods.name: CreateAndStartThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread with the given name, returning the thread wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC PeerConnectionFactory using the provided network, worker, and signaling threads, as well as an optional audio device module, returning it wrapped in a Result.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnection
methods.description: Creates a PeerConnection with specified ICE servers, port range, and factory, returning it wrapped in a Result.
